About Us

Your trusted accountant in Inner West Sydney

Ideal Business Group is a trusted accounting firm in the Inner West, supporting businesses and individuals with reliable and practical financial guidance. As a registered tax agent and CPA-qualified team, we are committed to helping you stay compliant and confident. We offer a full range of services including small business tax accounting, corporate tax returns, GST compliance services, business advisory, and SMSF accounting, helping you stay in control of your finances. As a leading tax accountant in Inner West Sydney, we go beyond compliance and we help you minimise tax, improve cash flow, and make better financial decisions. Our goal is to give you clarity, confidence, and the right support to grow your business.

  • Registered tax agent
  • CPA-qualified team
  • Small business specialists
  • SMSF & property tax

Frequently Asked Questions

We provide expert financial solutions, including accounting, tax planning, and business advisory.

Yes, we support businesses of all sizes with tailored financial solutions.
